content: {"summary":"On 22 Nov 2025 orders‑db‑01 refused new connections (error 53300) because all usable slots (297) were occupied. orders‑api can use at most 75 slots (3 pods × 25), and the remaining ~222 slots were held by idle sessions from a batch Job in the commerce namespace, exhausting the pool.","likely_cause":"Idle connections from a long‑running batch Job in the commerce namespace exhausted the usable connection slots on orders‑db‑01.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"orders‑api can use up to 75 connection slots (3 pods × 25)","evidence_ids":["RB-012#3"],"quote":"orders-db | orders-api, `pg` Pool `max` 25, 3 pods | 3 × 25 = 75"},{"text":"A batch Job in the commerce namespace held about 222 idle sessions","evidence_ids":["INC-0103#0"],"quote":"had been holding open about 222 sessions"},{"text":"The 222 idle sessions plus the 75 from orders‑api equal the usable total of 297 slots","evidence_ids":["INC-0103#1"],"quote":"222 idle sessions plus those 75 come to 297"}],"next_checks":["Query pg_stat_activity to confirm current idle sessions per client address","Review the batch Job’s connection handling and add it to the connection budget","Monitor connection slot usage and set alerts before reaching the usable limit"]}
